<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; TEXT-ALIGN: justify">a Maryland corporation hereby certifies to the State Department of Assessments and Taxation of Maryland that:</div>

</div>

<div><br>
</div>

<div style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; TEXT-ALIGN: left">The name of the corporation is Self Storage Group, Inc. (the "Corporation").</div>

<div><br>
</div>
